# One vector per distinct score in each equivalence class a base vector can
# reach: every class, and every answer the interpolation gives inside it.
#
# The scores are what the reference calculator FIRST publishes for the scheme
# answers, taken by running it over all 104,976 base vectors and keeping the
# first vector for each class-and-score pair. They are not this code's own
# output, which is the whole point: a mistyped table entry moves a score here.
#

# whose conditions and disclaimer NOTICE carries.
